## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2019-03-21: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.4 to the S-1/A
- 2019-04-08: IPO closed; TRA executed
- 2019-05-20: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.4 to the Q1 2019 10-Q

#### Indirect controlling-shareholder change (no TRA impact)

- 2021-01-29: LSEG closed its acquisition of Refinitiv; Refinitiv remains the contractual TRA party and the Permitted Holder definition was not triggered, so the TRA continues unmodified

## Explanation

Tradeweb Markets Inc. executed this TRA on April 8, 2019 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, agreeing to pay 50% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future redemptions or exchanges of TWM LLC Interests by the Continuing LLC Owners (Refinitiv, a set of pre-IPO bank holders, and management). The 50% rate is materially lower than the 85% conventional in Up-C TRAs and is worth flagging at the cross-firm timeline stage; the contract covers basis step-ups and imputed interest only (no pre-IPO NOL bucket). The January 2021 LSEG acquisition of Refinitiv changed the ultimate parent of the controlling Continuing LLC Owner but did not amend or trigger the TRA because Refinitiv remained the contractual party and is a Permitted Holder under the Section 4.1 Change of Control carve-out. The first TRA payment was made in January 2021; the recognized liability grew from $171.4M at IPO to $372.8M at Dec 31, 2024 and stood at $336.5M at Dec 31, 2025 after ongoing payments and a favorable remeasurement. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
